dual-cards.looks: Two white link cards side by side, each with a small icon and a title; the whole card is the link.
dual-cards.use: Two quick links, e.g. 'Search Missing Child Posters' and 'AMBER Alerts'.
dual-cards.avoid: Links that need a description: use Icon 1x4 Col Card (card-row-compact).

fields.icon: A small icon beside the title.
fields.title: Where the card goes, a few words, e.g. 'Search Missing Child Posters'.
fields.buttonText: Optional link words under the title.
fields.buttonLink: The address the whole card opens.
